title: Shape Hunt at Home
subject: math
learningGoal: Recognise circles, triangles, squares and rectangles by their sides and corners.
realWorldHook: Builders and designers choose shapes on purpose. Our home is full of them.
noPurchaseRoute: Nothing needed. Just walk around the house.
parentPreview: Your child hunts for shapes around the house and describes them by sides and corners, not just by name.

parent.parentSays: Our house is full of shapes. Can you spot one right now?
Send your child on a hunt: one round thing, one 3-sided thing and one 4-sided thing. They can point or bring them.
parent.whyThisWorks: Describing by sides and corners is more reliable than recognising a picture.

child.screen: Find something round, something with 3 sides, and something with 4 sides.
child.readAloudText: Find something round, something with three sides and something with four sides.

parent.parentSays: Pick your 4-sided thing. Are all the sides the same length? Then is it a square or a rectangle?

child.screen: A door has 4 sides. Square or rectangle?
child.readAloudText: A door has four sides. Is it a square or a rectangle?

parent.parentSays: How do you know your triangle is a triangle?

child.screen: How do you know it's a triangle?
child.readAloudText: How do you know it's a triangle? Tell your grown-up.

parent.parentSays: Ask the two check questions below. Give your child time to think, then note how each one went.
Which shape did we find the most?

expectedResponses: Shapes named by number of sides and corners

misconceptions.signal: Says a tilted square is a 'diamond' and not a square.
misconceptions.supportiveNextQuestion: If we turn it back, does it change? Count its sides and check if they're equal.
Does a square have four sides and four square corners like a rectangle?

checkQuestions.parentAsks: How many sides does a triangle have?

child.screen: How many sides does a triangle have?
child.readAloudText: How many sides does a triangle have?

checkQuestions.parentAsks: Why are wheels round and not square?

interpretation.clear: Explains that round things roll smoothly.
interpretation.partial: Says 'they just are' but tries a reason.

child.screen: Why are wheels round, not square?
child.readAloudText: Why are wheels round and not square? Tell your grown-up.

extension: Look for hexagons (honeycomb, nuts, pencils) and count their sides.

shorterVersion.description: Find just one 4-sided shape and talk about it.

accessibilityAdaptations: Trace shapes with a finger for a touch-based version.
